text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks). There 
was no trace of anxiety on Ikuno Dictus's 
face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she feels the heavy atmosphere 
unique to GⅠ races just as she did at the 
Oka Sho... she's already experienced it 
once before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The 2400m distance was an issue, but she 
had the confidence to run the whole way 
through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In contrast, Daiichi Ruby wore a tense 
expression. —At last, the Yushun Himba 
(Japanese Oaks) was about to begin!
